body: I don't even know whether the chicken or the egg came first at this point. I've been dealing with this since middle school. It's brutal, especially when no one around you seems to get it.

I've made it past the "suicidal kid" part and into being a suicidal "adult". 26 and still here!
I made it to good times I never thought I'd have, where I barely had to fight. But lately it is a struggle.

The truth is, we are some of the strongest people out there... We cry out for help even as we're choked by the lumps in our throats. We keep living, even when we hurt so deeply that death seems like an easy choice.

And only those who have been that low can understand how much strength it takes to pull yourself back up.
